solves.myAnswer: help us imagine how the world might be otherwise. certainly, we can't get to a different place if we can't imagine it." the piece below, titled homestead, is a painting by jon ching. most of his work, including this painting, is a celebration of nature and a quiet appeal to humans to appreciate the world around them. "i believe we've separated ourselves from nature and no longer see how we fit in. instead of helping nature thrive, we are simply consuming it," says ching. one cannot help but smile at his paintings, which are rich in color and tenderness. one of the fun aspects of his work is how he blends the features of one life form with those of another. "i've been using my work as a means of commenting on issues and problems i'm heavily interested in. i find it necessary to express a silver lining rather than just reflect on what's wrong. i want to show that everything is connected and that protecting nature is actually protecting us. my call to action is to remember the magic and wonder of this planet." art can strike up conversations about the environment, but more importantly, it can also make a great difference by inspiring us to take action. the following words from andy warhol, an american pop artist, ring especially true in this context. "they always say time changes things, but you actually have to change them yourself." banksy's new work in port talbot secretive street artist banksy designed another interesting piece of art, which appears on a concrete block garage in port talbot, wales. it shows a child catching snowflakes with his mouth. when you look around the corner, however, you realize that the child's mouth is open to ash coming from a dumpster fire. banksy was asked by gary owen, a port talbot resident, to create art that would highlight port talbot's dust problem. owen believed that the area's children were facing serious health risks by playing in the dust coming from the local steel plant. children are particularly defenseless against air pollution. since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more pollutants. according to the world health organization (who), about 93% of the world's children under 15 breathe in toxic air every day. in 2016, the who even estimated that about 600,000 children died from exposure to polluted air. banksy's art has included environmental messages before. for example, his 2010 artwork was created at the remains of a plant in detroit. it showed a child with a can of red paint and the words, "i remember when all this was trees."
